tools.name: list_upcoming_meetups
tools.description: Upcoming in-person tech meetups in Tel Aviv, soonest first. Use when=week for "what's on this week".

tools.name: search_meetups
tools.description: Search upcoming meetups. Combine any of: free text (title, topic, organizer, venue; Hebrew or English, every word must match), a topic tag, a date range, a time window and exclude_paid. Tags: ai (AI), data (דאטה), cloud (תשתיות), security (סייבר), frontend (פרונט), startups (סטארטאפים), makers (מייק

tools.name: get_meetup
tools.description: Full details of one meetup by id (ids come from the list and search tools).

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Topic tags with how many upcoming meetups each has. Pass a tag id to search_meetups.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: The public calendars, Meetup groups, Luma pages, conferences, venues and company event pages the list is updated from daily. Filter by kind or free text (name or topic).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_sources" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The public calendars, Meetup groups, Luma pages, conferences, venues and company event pages the bot scans daily. Filter by kind or free text (name or topic)." → after: "The public calendars, Meetup groups, Luma pages, conferences, venues and company event pages the list is updated from daily. Filter by kind or free text (name or topic)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
